key_findings: Narrative review of five nonsurgical neurolytic procedures (cryoablation, radiofrequency ablation, alcohol, phenol, capsaicin 8% patch) for refractory neuropathic pain.
Pain relief from these procedures typically lasts 3 to 12 months, with repeat procedures often needed.
